[^pipeline]: Build-time execution, freeze, listings, RSS, and GitHub Pages deploy. ## Querying a DataFrame with SQL ::: {#b94f188c .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import duckdb import polars as pl df = pl.DataFrame({ "species": ["adelie", "gentoo", "chinstrap", "adelie", "gentoo"], "bill_mm": [38.8, 47.5, 48.8, 39.2, 46.1], }) avg_bills = duckdb.sql( "SELECT species, avg(bill_mm) AS avg_bill FROM df GROUP BY species ORDER BY avg_bill" ).pl() avg_bills ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ```{=html}
